_about: Answer key for the 17 official sample questions (eval/sample_questions.md). Each expected rule and figure was read from the rule text in data/source (MP Bhumi Vikas Rules 2012, consolidated to 06-03-2025) and, for table figures, checked against the official PDF page. 'rules' lists every rule that correctly answers the question; citing any one of them counts as a hit. 'figures' are numbers that must appear in the answer or in the calculator output.

questions.q: My house faces a 10 m wide street and will be 9 m tall. How much open space do I leave at the front?
questions.note: Rule 56(1)(a), page 77: street more than 9 m and up to 12 m -> 3.6 m.

questions.q: I want a farm house on agricultural land. What is the minimum plot size and the maximum FAR?
My development permission was granted in 2023. How long does it stay valid, and how many times can I renew it?
questions.note: Rule 23(1) valid up to three years; 23(2) revalidation for two consecutive terms of one year each.

questions.q: I applied for building permission and the authority has not replied. What happens if they miss the deadline?
questions.note: Rule 28: deemed sanctioned if refusal not intimated within the period in Section 30(5) of the Act; not for applications through authorised Architect/Structural Engineer.

questions.q: How far must my balcony stay from a low-voltage overhead electric line, vertically and horizontally?
questions.note: Rule 52(1) table row (a): 2.5 m vertically, 1.2 m horizontally.

questions.q: Who is allowed to sign and submit my building plans?
questions.note: Rule 18: licensed architect, structural engineer, engineer, supervisor or town planner, plus the owner; types per Rule 26.

questions.q: What documents go with an application for building permission?
What is the fee for building permission for a residential house?
questions.note: Rule 21(2)(ii) application fee Rs 1/sq m; 21(3)(b) Item 1 permission fee slabs (page 36).

questions.q: Can I change my plan after it is sanctioned?
questions.note: Rule 24 deviation from sanctioned plan (limits); Rule 21(3)(b) items 7-8 fees for alteration.

questions.q: What is the minimum rear open space for a 150 sq m residential plot?
questions.note: Rule 56(2)(a), page 78: above 40 and up to 150 sq m -> 1.50 m.

questions.q: Do I need separate development permission for a 300 sq m plot that matches the Development Plan? (Tip: this changed in August 2026.)
questions.note: Rule 2(5) in the consolidated rules; amended 28-08-2026: plots up to 500 sq m conforming to the Development Plan need no separate development permission. The tool must flag the amendment.

questions.q: Which rule decides what happens when the Development Plan and these rules disagree?
questions.note: Rule 103: Development Plan norms take precedence; if contrary, Director sends proposal to Government, whose decision is final.

questions.q: What are the rules for lifts in a building taller than 15 m?
questions.note: Rule 83: lifts required above 12.5 m; NBC Part VIII Section 5; Appendix A-2(A) and E-3(A).

questions.q: मेरा प्लॉट 200 वर्ग मीटर का है और सामने 9 मीटर चौड़ी सड़क है। आगे कितनी जगह खाली छोड़नी होगी?
questions.note: Rule 56(1)(a), page 77: street up to 9.0 m -> 3.0 m.

questions.q: बिल्डिंग परमिशन की फीस कितनी है और किस नियम में लिखी है?
How do I pay my property tax online?
What is the current market rate for land in Kolar Road, Bhopal?
